card: Switches native Windows builds and CI from MSVC (cl.exe) to clang-cl, dropping support for cl.exe. Native builds with cl.exe lacked inline assembly support on x64/ARM64 and regularly required workarounds for compiler bugs and internal errors (#31456, #36153). Author benchmarks report block connection throughput increasing by ~55–60% and Windows CI build times dropping by 38%. Developers building natively on Windows must install Visual Studio's Clang C++ tools and use Visual Studio 18.7 or newer.
changed_since_previous: Refined CMake diagnostic and library configuration, including using BOOL:${MSVC} for shlwapi linkage in bitcoinqt and adjusting warning flags.

enables: Hardware-accelerated inline assembly optimizations on Windows (e.g., secp256k1 #1681)

evidence: PR description benchmarks show block connection performance increasing by ~55–60% with clang-cl over MSVC (e.g., ConnectBlockAllEcdsa from 7.40 to 11.52 blocks/s; DeserializeBlockTest from 121.46 to 189.04 blocks/s).
PR description CI measurements show build times dropping from 20m 35s on MSVC to 12m 43s on clang-cl.
Closes #31456 (tracking MSVC compilation issues and maintenance overhead) and #36153 (MSVC bug evaluating requires-expressions during constant evaluation).
problem: Native Windows compilation with `cl.exe` lacks inline assembly support on x64 and ARM64, runs slower on CI, produces slower binaries, and creates recurring maintenance overhead due to compiler bugs and internal compiler errors (#31456, #36153).

risk.why: Mistakes in compiler options, builtins linkage, or architecture flags could break native Windows builds or yield miscompiled Windows binaries.

scope_notes: Drops support for compiling with cl.exe entirely; Windows native developers must install the Clang C++ tools and Visual Studio 18.7 or newer.
summary: Switches native Windows builds and CI from MSVC (`cl.exe`) to Clang (`clang-cl.exe`), dropping support for compiling with `cl.exe`. Updates CMake configuration, diagnostic flags, and feature introspection tests for Clang's MSVC-compatible frontend, and links Clang's runtime builtins library for 128-bit integer operations. Removes several MSVC workarounds, including non-`constexpr` byte-swap helpers and disabled constant-evaluation tests, while raising the minimum Visual Studio version to 18.7.
